title: shiply
description: Publish any app in one call: SQL database, functions, email, and a custom domain. Flat price.
summary: Publish any app in one call: SQL database, functions, email, and a custom domain. Flat price.
offersHint: Publish any app in one call: SQL database, functions, email, and a custom domain. Flat price. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://shiply.now/mcp

toolsPreview.name: publish_site
toolsPreview.description: Publish files to the web → live URL at <slug>.shiply.now. UPDATING: never create a new site for changes — re-call with claimToken (anonymous sites) or slug (sites you own with a Bearer key) and the SAME URL gets the new version. Unchanged files are hash-skipped server-side, so re-publishing (including retrying a failed publish) is cheap — always update the same site rather than creating a new one. Works WITHOUT auth (anonymous: 24h lifetime, returns claimToken/claimUrl — SAVE THEM). With a Bearer shp_ key sites are permanent. ≤50 files / 2 MB inline; bigger: REST flow per https://shiply.now/llms.txt. index.html serves at /. spaMode for client-side routing.

toolsPreview.name: site_status
toolsPreview.description: Check any shiply slug or custom hostname: TLS certificate (issuer, days left) + HTTPS probe. ready=true means live.

toolsPreview.name: verify_site
toolsPreview.description: Edge-check a shiply slug or custom hostname and return a structured readiness report: status (LIVE/PENDING), SSL details (valid, issuer, daysLeft), HTTP probe, and a presigned thumbnail URL when available. Use this after publishing to confirm the site is reachable.

toolsPreview.name: list_sites
toolsPreview.description: List the sites owned by this API key. Optional clientId filters to one client.

toolsPreview.name: get_site
toolsPreview.description: Site settings + version history for one of my sites.

toolsPreview.name: delete_site
toolsPreview.description: PERMANENTLY delete a site and all stored files. Irreversible — confirm with the user first.

toolsPreview.name: rollback_site
toolsPreview.description: Re-point a site to any finalized version (rollback or roll-forward). Get version ids from get_site. Serving updates immediately.

toolsPreview.name: list_versions
toolsPreview.description: List a site's finalized deploys newest-first (id, createdAt, isLive, fileCount, bytes), capped at 20. Pair with rollback_site: pick a version id from here and re-point the site to it.

toolsPreview.name: pull_site
toolsPreview.description: Download the current files of a site you own (or created via a platform connection) so you can edit and republish to the same slug with publish_site. Static sites return editable source; framework/SSR sites return the built bundle (`.shiply/bundle/*`), not original source.

toolsPreview.name: set_handle
toolsPreview.description: Give ONE site a vanity URL: rename it to <handle>.shiply.now (3-30 chars, a-z 0-9 -). The old address 301-redirects for 30 days. (For a portfolio page listing all your sites, use set_profile instead — that lives at shiply.now/@<handle>.)

toolsPreview.name: duplicate_site
toolsPreview.description: Server-side copy of an owned site under a new slug — instantly live. Copies files + title; does NOT copy access settings, domains, or data. Great for iterating on variants.

toolsPreview.name: promote_site
toolsPreview.description: Copy the EXACT live bytes of one owned site (srcSlug — your preview) into another owned site (destSlug — your production site / custom domain), no rebuild. Dest keeps its slug, domains, and access settings; only the served bytes change.

toolsPreview.name: set_link
toolsPreview.description: Path-mounting: serve an owned target site at a path on an owned host site (host/docs -> target). location is a path like "docs", or "__root__" for the host root. Both sites must be owned by you. Pass remove=true to unmount.

toolsPreview.name: set_site_access
toolsPreview.description: Protect an owned site (paid plans). mode 'public' (anyone), 'password' (supply password), or 'restricted' (supply allowedEmails and/or allowedDomains — only those can request a login code). Changing any setting signs out existing visitors.

toolsPreview.name: get_site_access
toolsPreview.description: Read an owned site's current access policy (mode: public/password/restricted, allowedEmails, allowedDomains, hasPassword). Read-only counterpart to set_site_access — check before changing it.

toolsPreview.name: export_account
toolsPreview.description: Return a JSON bundle of the user's profile, sites, Site Data, drives, and metadata (secrets excluded). Data portability.

toolsPreview.name: whoami
toolsPreview.description: Who am I? Returns the signed-in account: email, @handle, plan + limits, counts of sites/domains/drives, and connected DNS providers. Call this first to orient before managing sites or domains.

toolsPreview.name: get_account_status
toolsPreview.description: Get the signed-in account's plan, capabilities, and upgrade URL. Call this FIRST when figuring out what features you have access to — it tells you exactly what's available and what's blocked. The upgrade_url is human-clickable; show it in chat when a feature requires a higher plan. Returns plan id + name + subscription status, hard limits (sites, databases, custom domains, drives), and a capability matrix listing every gated feature (workers_lite, databases_neon_postgres, custom_domains, etc.) with whether you have access and the minimum plan needed.

toolsPreview.name: list_drives
toolsPreview.description: List the user's private cloud Drives (id, name). Optional clientId filters to one client.

toolsPreview.name: create_drive
toolsPreview.description: Create a private cloud Drive (plan-limited). Pass client to file it under a client.

toolsPreview.name: drive_list_files
toolsPreview.description: List files in a Drive (driveId = drv_…, or "default"). Optional prefix filter.

toolsPreview.name: drive_put_file
toolsPreview.description: Write a file into a Drive (driveId = drv_… or "default"). content is utf8 or base64. Use for agent memory, notes, context, assets.

toolsPreview.name: drive_delete_file
toolsPreview.description: Delete a file from a Drive.

toolsPreview.name: publish_from_drive
toolsPreview.description: Snapshot a Drive (or a prefix of it) into a new live site at <slug>.shiply.now. Files copied server-side.

toolsPreview.name: set_profile
toolsPreview.description: Create or update the user's public PORTFOLIO page at shiply.now/@<handle> (handle 3-30 chars a-z0-9-) — a landing page listing the user's sites. This is NOT a site's address: to give one site a vanity URL like <handle>.shiply.now, use set_handle instead. enable shows the profile; autoAdd auto-lists new sites. Use after publishing to give the user a shareable portfolio.

toolsPreview.name: feature_site
toolsPreview.description: Toggle whether an owned, public site appears in the public shiply Explore gallery (https://shiply.now/explore). Only public-access sites are eligible.

toolsPreview.name: set_variable
toolsPreview.description: Upsert a key/value in the user's encrypted variable store (UPPER_SNAKE name, ≤8 KiB value). Use for API keys the user's sites/agents need, e.g. SUPABASE_URL. NOTE: saving alone does NOT expose it to any site Worker's env — attach it to a specific site with attach_variable (takes effect on that site's next function deploy).

toolsPreview.name: list_variables
toolsPreview.description: List the encrypted variables. Values are masked unless reveal=true.

toolsPreview.name: delete_variable
toolsPreview.description: Remove one variable by name.

toolsPreview.name: attach_variable
toolsPreview.description: Expose one saved variable to ONE owned site's Worker env (plain_text binding). Opt-in per site — unattached variables are never injected, because the Worker runs the site's own code. Takes effect on the site's next function deploy.

toolsPreview.name: detach_variable
toolsPreview.description: Stop exposing a variable to a site's Worker env. Takes effect on the site's next function deploy.

toolsPreview.name: list_site_variables
toolsPreview.description: Names of the variables attached to an owned site's Worker env (values never shown here).

toolsPreview.name: list_databases
toolsPreview.description: List the SQL databases (D1 or Neon Postgres) on my account, including which owned site (if any) each is attached to. Call this BEFORE db_query/db_schema-style work to discover a databaseId — those live on a per-database MCP server reached via GET /api/v1/databases/{id} (see llms.txt), which this id feeds.

toolsPreview.name: create_database
toolsPreview.description: Provision a SQL database — D1 (default, free) or Neon Postgres (--postgres, developer plan). Optionally attach it to an owned site's Worker env in the same call (siteSlug); otherwise attach it later with attach_database.

toolsPreview.name: delete_database
toolsPreview.description: PERMANENTLY delete a database and all its data. Irreversible — confirm with the user first.

toolsPreview.name: attach_database
toolsPreview.description: Bind an existing database to one owned site's Worker env (the binding name chosen at create_database time). Takes effect on the site's next function/publish deploy.

toolsPreview.name: data_list_collections
toolsPreview.description: List collections declared in an owned site's .shiply/data.json with current record counts. Empty list means the site has no manifest yet — scaffold one with `shiply data init`.

toolsPreview.name: data_query
toolsPreview.description: Page records from an owned site's collection, newest-first. limit ≤ 200 (default 50). cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

toolsPreview.name: data_insert
toolsPreview.description: Insert one record into a collection. Goes through the same public visitor endpoint a browser would use — manifest access.insert decides whether it is allowed. Use to seed waitlist data, test forms end-to-end, etc.

toolsPreview.name: data_export_collection
toolsPreview.description: Return up to `limit` records (default 1000, max 5000) from a collection — for snapshotting into agent context. For larger sets use the CLI: `shiply data export <slug> <collection>`.

toolsPreview.name: add_domain
toolsPreview.description: Serve a site on a domain the user owns. Returns the CNAME to add (hostname → cname.shiply.now); the certificate issues automatically once DNS resolves. Poll with check_domain.

toolsPreview.name: add_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Register a registrable domain (e.g. example.com) the user owns and detect its DNS provider. Returns the provider and whether one-click connect is available. Then attach sites with add_subdomain.

toolsPreview.name: add_subdomain
toolsPreview.description: Serve an owned site at <subdomain>.<domain> (use subdomain "@" or "" for the apex — apex needs a provider with CNAME flattening/ALIAS, e.g. Cloudflare). Auto-registers the parent domain. Returns the CNAME record to add (host -> cname.shiply.now); the certificate issues automatically once DNS resolves. Poll with check_domain.

toolsPreview.name: set_primary_subdomain
toolsPreview.description: Mark a hostname as the primary (canonical) URL for its site. Sibling hostnames (apex + www both pointed at the same site) start 301-redirecting to it, preserving path + query. The host-side fix for the duplicate-content SEO problem. The first subdomain you add for a site is primary by default; call this only when you need to switch.

toolsPreview.name: list_custom_domains
toolsPreview.description: List registered custom domains grouped with their subdomains, each subdomain's site and status, and the detected provider.

toolsPreview.name: connect_provider
toolsPreview.description: Start one-click DNS connect for a registered custom domain. For Cloudflare-hosted domains this returns an authorize URL — SHOW THE USER the url as a clickable link; after they authorize, records are written automatically. For other providers, add the records manually.

toolsPreview.name: sync_dns
toolsPreview.description: For a connected custom domain, (re)write the CNAME records for all its subdomains automatically and report what changed. For unconnected domains, returns the records to add manually.

toolsPreview.name: check_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a custom domain's subdomains are live: re-polls Cloudflare cert status + probes DNS/TLS/HTTPS on each subdomain. Poll this after connect_provider / add_subdomain to confirm the domain is serving. Returns per-subdomain status + tls + http + ready.

toolsPreview.name: remove_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Remove a registered custom domain and all its subdomains; they stop serving immediately.

toolsPreview.name: list_domains
toolsPreview.description: List connected custom domains with status.

toolsPreview.name: check_domain
toolsPreview.description: Refresh certificate status + live TLS/HTTPS probe for a connected domain (by id from list_domains).

toolsPreview.name: remove_domain
toolsPreview.description: Remove a connected domain (by id). It stops serving immediately.

toolsPreview.name: get_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Daily page views per site for the last 30 days.

toolsPreview.name: create_test
toolsPreview.description: Provision a demand test in one call: deploys a landing page with a native email-capture form and creates a confirmed-subscriber segment. Returns testId + live siteUrl. Share the siteUrl to collect signups; each signup gets a double-opt-in confirmation. Read progress with get_test_status.

toolsPreview.name: list_tests
toolsPreview.description: List your demand tests with signups + confirmed counts.

toolsPreview.name: get_test_status
toolsPreview.description: ONE consolidated object: page funnel (views, signups, confirmed, conversion) ⊕ email events (delivered/opened/clicked/bounced) ⊕ a computed verdict. The single place to check progress — never query email separately.

toolsPreview.name: send_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: Send a campaign to this test's confirmed (double-opt-in) subscribers — the "we're live" email. An unsubscribe link is added automatically. Fails if there are no confirmed subscribers yet.

toolsPreview.name: resend_confirmation
toolsPreview.description: Re-send the double-opt-in confirmation to a signup that has not confirmed yet.

toolsPreview.name: verify_claim
toolsPreview.description: Confirm a pairing code shown in the user's browser at https://shiply.now/claim/<slug>?pair=1. Use ONLY in the agent session that originally published the site — it reads the claimToken from .shiply.json in the current working directory and proves to Shiply that this agent session is authorised to claim the site. After verification the user is auto-redirected to /welcome and the site binds to their account.

toolsPreview.name: list_inbox
toolsPreview.description: List the user's email inbox threads (outbound demand-test sends + inbound replies / unsubscribes / complaints / bounces). Filter by tag.

toolsPreview.name: read_thread
toolsPreview.description: Return the thread metadata + all messages in chronological order. Use list_inbox first to get a threadId.

toolsPreview.name: summarize_thread
toolsPreview.description: One-paragraph summary of the thread, oriented to the most actionable signal (interest, complaint, question, unsubscribe).

toolsPreview.name: reply_to_thread
toolsPreview.description: Send an email reply on an existing thread. Goes FROM the original recipient address (the <slug>@shiply.now alias the sender used) and TO the original sender. Threaded via RFC 5322 In-Reply-To so Gmail/Outlook group it with the original. Subject defaults to 'Re: <original>' when omitted. Cap at 20,000 chars. Use after read_thread to make sure you're replying to the right conversation.

toolsPreview.name: mark_thread_read
toolsPreview.description: Zero the unread counter for a thread. Useful after the agent has read but not acted. read_thread already calls this implicitly; use this explicitly when you want to clear unread without re-fetching the thread body.

toolsPreview.name: archive_thread
toolsPreview.description: Soft-archive the thread (sets archivedAt). Hidden from the default inbox view; surface again with list_inbox filter=archived. Reverse with unarchive_thread.

toolsPreview.name: unarchive_thread
toolsPreview.description: Restore an archived thread (clears archivedAt). It reappears in the default inbox list. Pair with list_inbox filter=archived to find archived threadIds first.

toolsPreview.name: forward_thread
toolsPreview.description: Forward a message from a thread (default: the most recent message) to a NEW recipient with an optional intro note. Body is composed as note + standard '---------- Forwarded message ----------' quote of the original. Goes from the thread's existing shiply alias so replies still route through the inbox. Subject defaults to 'Fwd: <original>'.

toolsPreview.name: list_test_inbox_addresses
toolsPreview.description: Return every active demand test's reply / inbound address (<slug>@<sitesDomain>). Use this when you need to TELL someone where to email — e.g. drafting a reply or sharing a test's contact address. Mail sent to these aliases lands in /dashboard/inbox tied to the test.

toolsPreview.name: list_unsubscribes
toolsPreview.description: Shortcut for list_inbox with filter=unsubscribes — shows every thread tagged as an opt-out request.

toolsPreview.name: list_suppressions
toolsPreview.description: Return the user's suppression list — addresses (and full domains) that shiply skips when sending. Bounces, complaints, manual user adds, and AI-detected unsubscribes all land here.

toolsPreview.name: add_suppression
toolsPreview.description: Add an address (or whole domain) to the user's suppression list. Future confirmations and broadcasts will skip it across every test. Use kind='email' for a single address, kind='domain' for everyone @example.com.

toolsPreview.name: remove_suppression
toolsPreview.description: Delete one suppression by id. Use list_suppressions first to find the id.

toolsPreview.name: list_complaints
toolsPreview.description: Return threads tagged as complaints (spam reports) OR bounces (recipient rejected). Read these before any further sending.

toolsPreview.name: list_projects
toolsPreview.description: List the dev's customer-intake projects (newest first). Optional filters: status (draft|intake_open|brief_ready|brief_failed|archived), q (case-insensitive match on label or customer email), limit (default 100). Use to triage what's in flight before opening a specific project.

toolsPreview.name: create_project
toolsPreview.description: Spin up a new customer-intake project on the dev's account. Returns the project row plus intakeUrl — the public link the customer fills out (10-step wizard). If customerEmail is provided, shiply also emails them the intake invite. Use originatedFromSiteId to link a project to an existing site (e.g. 'redesign this site').

toolsPreview.name: get_project
toolsPreview.description: Read one of the dev's projects by id — includes label, status, customer details, intake responses, AI brief, drive folder. Use before update_brief / regenerate_brief.

toolsPreview.name: update_brief
toolsPreview.description: Overwrite the project's working brief (jsonb). Hard-capped at 500 KB. Use to revise the AI-generated brief by hand; the original AI output is preserved separately in briefAiOriginal so you can always compare. Does not change status.

toolsPreview.name: regenerate_brief
toolsPreview.description: Re-run the MiniMax/Anthropic brief generator from the project's current intake_responses and persist the result. Flips status to brief_ready on success or brief_failed on error. Use after the customer edits answers post-submit, or when the first AI attempt failed.

toolsPreview.name: archive_project
toolsPreview.description: Move a project to status='archived'. Hidden from the default dashboard list. Optional reason is shown on the project page. Restore later with restore_project.

toolsPreview.name: restore_project
toolsPreview.description: Move an archived project back to status='draft' so it reappears in the active list. Idempotent on non-archived projects? No — server rejects the transition unless the project is currently archived.

toolsPreview.name: list_project_files
toolsPreview.description: Return the customer-uploaded files for one project (path, size, contentType, createdAt). Empty when no drive folder exists yet (no uploads). Use to inspect what intake assets the customer attached.

toolsPreview.name: resend_intake_invite
toolsPreview.description: Re-fire the 'your developer sent you a project intake' email to the project's customer. Throws invalid_request if the project has no customerEmail (the dev needs to set one via the dashboard first — customer email isn't agent-patchable). Use when the customer says they didn't receive the link.

toolsPreview.name: list_listings
toolsPreview.description: Return every marketplace listing the seller owns (any status: draft, live, paused, sold). Includes site slug and current price. Use to see what's for sale across the account.

toolsPreview.name: create_listing
toolsPreview.description: Publish (or upsert) a marketplace listing for an owned site. Requires Stripe Connect set up (status='ready' — see get_connect_status). priceCents = whole-dollar between 100 and 999900. termsMode='standard' uses shiply's template; 'custom' requires termsCustom ≥50 chars. jurisdiction is required (e.g. 'California, USA').

toolsPreview.name: update_listing
toolsPreview.description: Patch a listing by siteSlug — change price, pitch, terms, jurisdiction, or status (draft|live|paused). Sold listings cannot be edited. Status transitions enforced server-side. Use to pause sales or drop the price.

toolsPreview.name: delete_listing
toolsPreview.description: Take a listing off the public marketplace by moving it to status='draft'. Marketplace v1 keeps the row so analytics + future re-listing work — there's no hard delete. Sold listings can't be modified. Use to stop accepting offers without losing pricing history.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_sales
toolsPreview.description: Return every marketplace order for sites the user sold (incl. pending, paid, refunded, failed, disputed). Most recent first. Use to surface revenue + which orders are still inside the 30-day refund window (refundExpiresAt > now).

toolsPreview.name: list_my_orders
toolsPreview.description: Return every marketplace order the user PURCHASED. Most recent first. Shows the acquired site, paid amount, and whether the order is still inside the 30-day refund window. Use to recap what the user owns by purchase.

toolsPreview.name: refund_order
toolsPreview.description: Issue a full refund on a paid order the user sold. Must be inside the 30-day refund window (server enforces). Triggers a Stripe refund; the webhook flips the order to 'refunded' and reverts site ownership to the seller. Idempotent on already-refunded orders.

toolsPreview.name: get_connect_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the seller's Stripe Connect state: not_started | in_progress | pending_verification | ready | disabled. When status != 'ready' the user can't list sites. Includes a one-shot onboardingUrl (if not_started or in_progress) and dashboardUrl (if ready). Refreshes from Stripe on every call.

toolsPreview.name: list_sending_domains
toolsPreview.description: Return every BYO sending domain the user has added (id, domain, fromAddress, status: pending|verified|failed, DNS records). Use to inspect verification state or find the id of a domain to verify/remove.

toolsPreview.name: add_sending_domain
toolsPreview.description: Register a domain the user owns for outbound demand-test sends. Returns DNS records (SPF, DKIM, MX) to add at the DNS provider. After DNS propagates, call verify_sending_domain. Cannot be a shiply.now subdomain.

toolsPreview.name: verify_sending_domain
toolsPreview.description: Trigger Resend to re-check the domain's DNS records, persist the new status. Call after adding the DNS records returned by add_sending_domain. Status flips to 'verified' once SPF + DKIM + MX all check out.

toolsPreview.name: remove_sending_domain
toolsPreview.description: Delete a BYO sending domain. Any demand tests bound to it fall back to the managed shiply sender. Also GCs the underlying Resend domain. Irreversible — re-adding requires re-verifying DNS.

toolsPreview.name: contract_draft
toolsPreview.description: Draft a contract from a brief_ready project. Auto-fills 8 fields from the AI brief, Stripe Connect default currency, and dev profile. Returns the contract row with status='draft' so the dev can review fields before sending. After this, edit fields via PATCH /api/v1/contracts/{id} (no MCP edit tool yet), then call contract_send to fire it.

toolsPreview.name: contract_send
toolsPreview.description: Send a draft contract to the customer. Validates all 8 fields are non-empty, computes content_hash, flips project to contract_sent, fires the customer email. Same handler works for amendment drafts — sending an amendment does not move project state.

toolsPreview.name: contract_amend
toolsPreview.description: Create an amendment to a SIGNED parent contract. Scope delta required; fee delta and target date optional. Returns the draft amendment for editing before send — call contract_send with the returned amendment id to fire it. Cannot amend an amendment (amend the parent instead).

toolsPreview.name: contract_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Get the signed contract PDF as a base64-encoded download. PDF includes the contract, signature certificate, and any signed amendments. Returns { filename, contentType, base64 }. Errors with conflict:contract_not_signed if the parent contract has not been signed yet.

toolsPreview.name: contract_status
toolsPreview.description: Read the current state of a contract: status, sent_at, viewed_at, signed_at, signer info, content_hash, plus any amendments. Use this to check whether a customer has signed yet. Returns { contract, amendments } — the contract row matches GET /api/v1/contracts/{id}.

toolsPreview.name: deploy_function
toolsPreview.description: Deploy a Worker function to a site. The function runs on every request to <slug>.shiply.now and can receive webhooks, run on cron triggers, and access bindings (D1, secrets, env vars). Requires Developer plan. Use when the user wants webhook receivers, cron jobs, or a backend for their site.

toolsPreview.name: get_function
toolsPreview.description: Return the deployed function source + metadata for a site, or null if no function deployed.

toolsPreview.name: remove_function
toolsPreview.description: Remove the deployed Worker function from a site (and all its routes, secrets, and cron triggers). Site falls back to static-only serving. Irreversible.

toolsPreview.name: set_secret
toolsPreview.description: Set a CF Worker secret on a site's deployed function. Value is encrypted-at-rest and accessible as env.<NAME> inside the worker. Use for Stripe keys, Resend API keys, etc.

toolsPreview.name: list_secrets
toolsPreview.description: List secret names (values not returned) for a site's deployed function.

toolsPreview.name: remove_secret
toolsPreview.description: Remove a secret from a site's deployed function. The binding disappears on next request.

toolsPreview.name: list_crons
toolsPreview.description: List cron triggers for a site's deployed function. Each cron is (path, schedule, lastRunAt).

toolsPreview.name: set_cron
toolsPreview.description: Set or update a cron trigger on a site's deployed function. Schedule is crontab syntax (UTC). Path is the URL the cron handler should fire on (for the worker's scheduled() handler context).

toolsPreview.name: remove_cron
toolsPreview.description: Remove a cron trigger from a site's deployed function.

toolsPreview.name: get_function_logs
toolsPreview.description: Read recent runtime logs for a site's per-site Worker (console output, request summaries, exceptions) from Cloudflare Workers Observability — 7-day retention, newest first. Use this to debug a deployed function: each event has timestamp, level, message, outcome, statusCode, requestId, and CPU/wall time. Also returns a CF dashboard deep-link.

toolsPreview.name: send_email
toolsPreview.description: Send an email from <slug>.shiply.now's managed sender. The site can send transactional/notification email — no SMTP setup. Rate-limited and spam-checked; replies route back to the site inbox.

toolsPreview.name: list_site_inbox
toolsPreview.description: Read the email threads (received, sent, web captures) for the agent's sites. Optionally scoped to one site by slug.

toolsPreview.name: set_mailbox
toolsPreview.description: Turn a Site Data collection into a mailbox: double opt-in, owner notifications, sending domain, branding. Call once per (site, collection) to configure how captured leads are handled.

toolsPreview.name: list_mailbox_contacts
toolsPreview.description: List captured contacts for a (site, collection) mailbox, optionally filtered by status (signed_up/confirmed/unsubscribed). Returns email, status, confirmedAt, createdAt, and captured fields.

toolsPreview.name: send_mailbox_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: Send a one-shot broadcast to the confirmed (double-opt-in) subscribers of a (site, collection) mailbox. Spam-checked; unsubscribe footer auto-added. Fails if no confirmed subscribers exist yet.
